climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A south Central Coast AVA straddling Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties, the nation's third AVA. Its east-west valley lets cool Pacific wind and fog flow in, giving a mild climate and a longer growing season. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir are the leading grapes in the county.
